_comment: VERIFICATION ARM (2026-08-13) — does the field posture-C product now DECLARE
its realized code-bias datum on the S line?  Identical to
_pc305_ggq_tri_slant_20m in every estimation knob; only the output paths
differ, so the existing 40/40 run stays on disk as the BEFORE evidence.
What it proves.  Before this card the S line of that run read
S,MBAR00UGA,1,nominal,0,0,1,0,0.05,0,COD...,E:E02,G:G01,atx=,oref=,pdr=,discfrac=
with NO cbpin= and NO gfpin=.  The cbpin fill existed but read
this_epoch_if_pin_sel, gated `!clock_signal_basis_hold && emit_clock_disc`;
network.emit_clock_disc defaults false and appears NOWHERE in this arm's
eight-config extends closure, so the declaration was structurally inert on
every FIELD posture while the sim arms (which arm the knob) declared fine.
simnet_grade.py REFUSES the SS4.4 S-transform without a declared pair, which
is what blocked truth-grading of field products.
PASS = the S line gains `cbpin=E:C1C-C5Q,cbpin=G:C1C-C2W` and
`gfpin=E:C1C-C5Q,gfpin=G:C1C-C2W` (order is std::map key order), the epoch
count still reads 40/40, and no estimation number moves — the change is
declaration-only (a scratch map read at the emit site; the solve never sees
it).  A cbpin= without a gfpin= would mean the GF tally is wrong; a gfpin=
without a cbpin= would mean the two declarations disagree about the pair.
Field runs are Release-only (standing directive).  Run through a renamed exe
copy so a concurrent rebuild cannot lock the binary mid-run.

//uwl: NOT a posture choice — a repair.  As of 2026-08-13 the parent config (under
a concurrent session's edit) disarms ewl_enable while an ancestor still sets
uwl_enable: true, and the loader hard-errors on that pair ('uwl_enable
requires ewl_enable'), so the parent does not currently LOAD.  Disarming the
orphaned top tier restores exactly the posture the parent's own comment says
it wants.  Delete this block once the parent is consistent again.
